body.name: bassem_research
body.description: Starts or follows a DEEPER search-and-write job (20-90 s) that makes a document on the screen: buyers for a product, tenders and RFQs, an export plan for one market, a company profile, a quotation draft, marketing posts, an e-mail sequence, a translation, or a tender / market summary. Call it in the SAME step as janna_lookup and bassem_intel when the member wants buyers, tenders, an export plan or anything written, and always when they found nothing; not bassem_web_hunt for the same request. For buyers, ask the buying industries first. action start answers at once: say its line in one sentence, go on with the other tools' results and ask ONE useful question. The result comes later in a note «[ملاحظة من المنصة: نتيجة البحث …]» and on the screen: say only what it says. Never name a source, a site or a link. «خلصت؟»: action status with the label. action mail e-mails the finished document to the member: say «اتبعت» only if the result says so. Never put a person's name, phone or e-mail in any field.

action.description: start a job; status = how far a job is (send its label); mail = e-mail the finished document to the signed-in member's own address

kind.description: buyers = who could buy the product (also tenders and RFQs); answer = a research question; export_plan = one market; company_profile = his company (subject «mine») or another; quote = a quotation draft from what he said; posts = marketing posts; emails = an e-mail sequence to buyers; translate = a text he gave; summary = one tender (ref) or a market

product.description: 1-3 names of the product or service as he said them, Arabic and/or English

buyer_industries.description: industries whose plants buy or use it (required for buyers)

question.description: answer / summary: the question in his words

details.description: quote / posts / emails / translate: the facts he GAVE (items, quantities, prices he said, terms, tone) or the text to translate — never invent any

buyer.description: quote: the buying entity, if he named it

ref.description: summary: an item from an earlier result: item:tenders:<id> or intel:<id>

doc_lang.description: the document's language code (ar, en, fr …); default: the language you are speaking

use_profile.description: use what is saved in his factory profile (products, capacity, markets); default true for company_profile, quote, posts, emails
